title: Graduate or undergraduate civil engineer - expression of interest
location: Southeast Queensland (Brisbane, Ipswich, Gold Coast, Warwick, Mount Isa)
content_text:
Osborn Consulting Engineers People and Careers page (read 9 Oct 2026 AEST).
Graduates / Undergraduates: If you are studying towards a Bachelor of Engineering qualification or have recently graduated and looking for hands on practical approach and interesting / exciting projects then reach out to us. Osborn Consulting have multiple offices, Brisbane, Mount Isa, Warwick, Ipswich, Gold Coast and remote other locations.
How to apply: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience to admin@osbornconsulting.com.au or via the submission box on the careers page.
Civil Designer / Drafter contract in Ipswich listed as starting May 2025 (stale timing); graduate/undergraduate path is a standing invitation.
No citizenship or PR requirement is stated on the Graduates / Undergraduates section (unlike Lead Civil Engineer, which asks for PR or progressing toward citizenship).
apply_instructions: Email resume and cover letter to admin@osbornconsulting.com.au (published on careers page as the application path).

title: Graduate Engineer Program (civil) - Melbourne or Brisbane
content_text:
Bornhorst + Ward careers and Graduate Program apply form (read 9 Oct 2026 AEST).
Graduate Engineers: Applications are accepted annually. Submit cover letter and resume via https://www.bornhorstward.com.au/apply. Form fields include full working rights in Australia, discipline (Structural / Civil), cover letter and CV uploads.
Civil engineering discipline: masterplanning and detailed design of roadworks, earthworks, stormwater drainage, sewer and water systems for subdivisions, carparks, shopping centres, road upgrades, sportsfields and parks.
Melbourne office: L4 - 400 Collins Street, Melbourne VIC 3000. Brisbane office also listed.
Cadet Drafting Program applications for 2027 commence early 2027 (not open now). Undergraduate 2026/2027 placement program closed.
Separate Active Jobs EOI page states unrestricted working rights; the Graduate Program apply form asks for full working rights (not unrestricted). This record is for the Graduate Program form path.
apply_instructions: Submit Graduate Program application form at https://www.bornhorstward.com.au/apply with cover letter and CV.
screening_questions: Do you have full working rights in Australia?
